reading.body:
Megvii is recorded as a Beijing public company founded in 2011, with no products, cases, or MCP servers attached to it in this data.

That is the whole of it. The record confirms a legal identity, a founding year, a headquarters city, and a website, and nothing about what the company builds or operates. For a reader tracking AI compute, buildings, or power, this entry carries no load: there is no data center, no chip, no model, no facility, and no litigation to reason from.

The absence should not be read as a claim that Megvii does none of these things. It means the source material behind this record was limited to the company's own name treatment, in Latin and Chinese characters, and no product or technology description was available from it. A missing field is a gap in coverage, not a finding about the company.

What this data does not tell the reader is anything about scale, infrastructure, or constraint. It cannot be used to place Megvii in a compute supply chain, and it should not be cited as evidence either way.
